stalls.summaryZh: 30年老攤，雙層餅皮、蛋酥香脆、餡料飽滿，吃起來清爽；下午就排隊，晚一點可能賣完，建議買了趁熱吃。
stalls.summaryEn: 30-year stall: double wrapper, crunchy egg floss and generous fillings that stay light. Lines start in the afternoon and it can sell out; eat it right away.
